description: D1: the Frostbound Titan, the old kings' watcher frozen into the Hoarcrown's ice, came down onto the Rimeglass, the frozen tarn over the Hoarwatch. From Maera's lead (lead.frostbound.hearth: the watchers go up with fire and keep two balefires on its shore) or from finding the tarn: cross from the Hoarwatch onto the Rimeglass, bring him down, and tell Maera at Last Hearth (her outcome frost_fallen: the watchers stay on the thawed tarn, and she tells what the beacon's watchers see now - the storm over the Drowned Steps: quest.stormcaller_lead). Every stage completes on his death but Maera's. XP at each stage.

stages.objective: Cross from the Hoarwatch onto the Rimeglass
stages.waiting_text: The Rimeglass lies east of the Hoarwatch, above the Colossus Steps (stage 7); Last Hearth's waystone at their foot carries you close.

stages.objective: Bring down the Frostbound Titan in the Rimeglass's ice
Tell Maera at Last Hearth the cold is broken
